response.sql: SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE CAST(a.date AS TEXT) > '1994-06-17' AND CAST(a.date AS TEXT) < '1996-09-02' GROUP BY d.A3

assumptions.assumption: account.date is stored as text in YYYY-MM-DD form, so the text comparison against '1994-06-17' and '1996-09-02' works as the request specifies (strict bounds on both ends).
An inner join to district enforces the 'district appears in the district table' condition. Regions with no qualifying accounts are not shown.
